$comment: M3 Step 1 — legacy → Backpack V2 mapping manifest. Machine-readable. Every record traces back to a verified fact in docs/backpack_v2/m3_legacy_inventory_discovery_report.md. No mapping in this file was invented: fields the report does not establish are set to "UNRESOLVED" with an unresolved_reason explaining what is missing and why it was not guessed.

generated_from.generated_against: clean local supabase db reset, full tracked migration history through 20261120000002_backpack_v2_hardening.sql
generated_from.note: Local reset has zero real ownership rows. Any record whose resolution depends on data shape only observable in production (e.g. store_items, real backpack_items.item_type value set) is marked confidence_level: none / low and flagged for a production re-check before the real backfill runs.

confidence_scale.high: Identifier resolution path is directly verified against existing schema/data (e.g. reuses an existing table's own primary key string via a verified join).
confidence_scale.medium: Identifier resolution path is verified, but a downstream detail (expiry semantics, coexistence with another system) is not yet decided.
confidence_scale.low: Core mechanics are understood but the target naming/identity is an open design question the discovery report explicitly flagged as undecided.
confidence_scale.none: No usable source data or identifier exists locally; production verification or a product decision is required before this can be resolved at all.

records.legacy_column: avatar_frames.frame_key (denormalized copy also present on user_avatar_frames.frame_key)
records.target_backpack_catalog_code: frame_catalog.code for the resolved key (reused verbatim via frame_legacy_map, not renamed)
records.asset_key: frame_catalog.asset_url / asset_type for the resolved code (caveat: backpack_catalog_items.asset_key has no populated convention anywhere yet — this is the closest available source value, not a confirmed final format)
records.ownership_source: user_avatar_frames row existence (no revocation flag on this table; row present = owned)
records.equipped_state_source: user_avatar_frames.is_equipped = true (not exclusivity-enforced by any DB constraint; production may contain more than one true row per user — dry-run report must surface this before backfill)
records.migration_rule: Resolve frame_key -> frame_legacy_map.code -> frame_catalog.code -> matching backpack_catalog_items.code (catalog row upserted from frame_catalog as part of this migration, keyed on code). Insert one user_backpack_items row per user_avatar_frames row, source_type='legacy_migration', source_reference='user_avatar_frames:'||id. Skip and log (to the migration issues table) any row whose frame_key has no frame_legacy_map/frame_catalog match.

records.legacy_item_category: Frame V2 ownership — the most mature existing system, not 'legacy' in the security-audit sense, but still a separate system from Backpack V2
records.asset_key: frame_catalog.asset_url / asset_type / thumbnail_url for the same row
records.ownership_source: user_frames row where revoked_at is null
records.equipped_state_source: UNRESOLVED — Frame V2 has no equipped flag on user_frames at all; equipped state lives separately on profiles.selected_avatar_frame_key, decoupled from ownership (discovery report Finding 4)
records.migration_rule: UNRESOLVED pending equipped-state decision. If proceeded: insert one user_backpack_items row per active (revoked_at is null) user_frames row, source_type='legacy_migration', source_reference='user_frames:'||id. Whether the resulting row should auto-equip based on a profiles.selected_avatar_frame_key string match is undecided.
records.unresolved_reason: Whether Backpack V2 becomes the new system of record for frames (deprecating user_frames) or coexists with it indefinitely is a product decision outside this report's scope. The equipped-state derivation via profiles.selected_avatar_frame_key is a denormalized string match, not a typed reference, and was not exercised against real data (0 rows in local reset).

records.equipped_state_source: user_badges.is_equipped = true (not exclusivity-enforced by any DB constraint; per discovery report Finding 5, no current UI renders equipped-badge state from either legacy system, so there is no live behavior to regress, but also none to validate against)
records.migration_rule: UNRESOLVED pending target_backpack_catalog_code decision. Once decided: one user_backpack_items row per user_badges row, source_type='legacy_migration' (uniformly — user_badges.source values such as 'level_reward'/'agency_reward' have no matching user_backpack_items.source_type CHECK value and are not preserved 1:1), source_reference='user_badges:'||id.
records.unresolved_reason: Discovery report §7 item 2 explicitly states whether badges.badge_key values are reused verbatim as backpack_catalog_items.code, or need a prefix/rename, is 'a design decision for the backfill migration, not something discoverable from data.' Not deciding this without user input, per 'do not invent mappings.'

records.legacy_column: metadata->>'frame_key' (NOT item_id — item_id has no foreign key and is unused by equip_backpack_item(), see discovery report Finding 2)
records.target_backpack_catalog_code: frame_catalog.code for the resolved key (same resolution path as R1)
records.expiry_source: UNRESOLVED — backpack_items has no expires_at column at all (see discovery report §6 full column inventory); grants via this path would migrate as permanent, which is unconfirmed against real product intent
records.equipped_state_source: backpack_items.equipped = true AND item_type = 'avatar_frame' (the only one of the three legacy equipped-flag systems that is actually exclusive, enforced per item_type inside equip_backpack_item())
records.migration_rule: For each backpack_items row where item_type='avatar_frame', read metadata->>'frame_key' as an untrusted string (per Finding 2) and resolve via frame_legacy_map — the same path equip_backpack_item() itself uses — to frame_catalog.code. Skip and log (do not insert) any row whose frame_key does not resolve. source_type='legacy_migration', source_reference='backpack_items:'||id.
records.unresolved_reason: Expiry semantics for this ownership path are unverified against real data — the source table has no expires_at column, so every row would migrate as a permanent grant. This needs confirmation it matches real product intent for gamification-store-purchased frames before running against production.

records.legacy_identifier: UNKNOWN — no row exists in local reset to observe any item_type value other than 'avatar_frame' (the only value the app's own equip_backpack_item() RPC handles)
records.migration_rule: DO NOT MIGRATE until backpack_items.item_type's real production value set is enumerated (e.g. `select distinct item_type from backpack_items`). The Step 2 dry-run report's 'unknown item codes' count surfaces whether any such rows exist at all.
records.unresolved_reason: backpack_items.item_type is an unconstrained text column (no CHECK constraint found in the schema inventory); its full real-world value set was never observed because the local reset has zero ownership rows. Migrating any non-'avatar_frame' value without first enumerating real production values would be inventing a mapping.

records.legacy_identifier: vip_levels.entrance_effect_key (populated seed values observed: sparkle, glow, premium, luxury, royal, legendary)
records.legacy_item_category: VIP-tier attribute — not an ownable per-user item today
records.target_backpack_catalog_code: UNRESOLVED — no existing naming convention observed for a per-tier entry-effect catalog code
records.asset_key: UNRESOLVED — no asset column exists for entrance effects anywhere in the schema inventory
records.ownership_source: SYNTHESIZED, not migrated — one grant per user where profiles.vip_level matches a tier and the subscription is currently active. There is no existing per-user ownership row for this category.
records.expiry_source: profiles.vip_expires_at (mirrors the VIP subscription's own expiry, not a separate per-item expiry)
records.equipped_state_source: UNRESOLVED — no existing 'currently equipped entry effect' concept exists anywhere; the tier's entrance effect is currently rendered unconditionally whenever VIP is active via lib/core/vip/vip_spec.dart, not via a discrete equip action
records.migration_rule: UNRESOLVED pending target_backpack_catalog_code and equipped-state decisions. Discovery report §7 item 3 calls this out as requiring one new catalog row per tier per category, synthesized (not migrated from any ownership row), cross-checked against vip_levels for the attribute set.
records.unresolved_reason: This is a synthesis, not a migration — no per-user ownership row exists anywhere for VIP-tier entry effects, only a tier-level attribute and the currently-active hardcoded renderer. Catalog code naming, asset_key sourcing, and default equipped-state are undecided design questions, not facts discoverable from data.

records.legacy_identifier: NONE — column exists but is NULL for every seed row
records.migration_rule: DO NOT MIGRATE — no source value exists locally to migrate or synthesize from.
records.unresolved_reason: vip_levels.mic_frame_url is present in the schema but unpopulated in every observed row (local reset). Production must be checked in case real values exist there that the tracked migration history never seeded locally.

records.legacy_identifier: NONE — column exists but is NULL for every seed row
records.migration_rule: DO NOT MIGRATE — no source value exists locally to migrate or synthesize from.
records.unresolved_reason: vip_levels.profile_frame_url is present in the schema but unpopulated in every observed row (local reset). Production must be checked in case real values exist there that the tracked migration history never seeded locally.

records.legacy_identifier: vip_plans.frame_key (nullable; populated for 6 of 9 levels per discovery report §1; level 1 has none), pointing into the avatar_frames/frame_catalog string space
records.legacy_item_category: VIP-tier avatar frame entitlement — distinct from R1/R2/R4, this is a tier-derived grant rather than a direct ownership row
records.target_backpack_catalog_code: UNRESOLVED — resolution path (frame_catalog.code for the matching frame_key) is plausible but not verified against real frame_legacy_map/frame_catalog data in the discovery report
records.ownership_source: SYNTHESIZED — one grant per active user_vip_subscriptions row (is_active = true, not yet expired) whose plan's level has a non-null frame_key
records.equipped_state_source: UNRESOLVED — unclear whether this should auto-equip, and whether it collides with an already-equipped R1/R2/R4 frame the same user may separately own
records.migration_rule: UNRESOLVED. Not addressed by the discovery report's §7 synthesis section at all — this is a gap surfaced during manifest construction, not something the report already resolved. Needs a decision on whether a VIP subscriber's tier frame_key represents ownership genuinely distinct from any avatar_frames/user_avatar_frames row they may separately hold, before any insert logic is written.
records.unresolved_reason: This source was identified in the discovery report's identifier table (§1) but never addressed in its synthesis section (§7). Whether vip_plans.frame_key represents a distinct ownable grant or is redundant with existing frame ownership rows for the same user was never checked against real data (0 rows everywhere locally). Do not migrate until confirmed.

records.legacy_identifier: NONE — badge_url is always NULL; badge_label is a display string, not a stable key
records.migration_rule: DO NOT MIGRATE — no key-shaped source column exists.
records.unresolved_reason: No populated, key-shaped identifier exists for a per-tier badge. badge_label is intended for display, not identity. Mapping it would mean inventing a key that does not exist in source data.

records.migration_rule: EXCLUDE. Confirmed 0 rows in every one of these tables in a clean reset, and per the original Phase-1 audit, no mutating RPC anywhere in the tracked migration history ever writes to either table. Nothing to migrate.

records.legacy_table: NONE — no table in the repository stores per-user ownership of any of these categories
records.migration_rule: NO MIGRATION. These categories start empty in Backpack V2; any future catalog rows are authored fresh, not backfilled. Confirmed by both the original Phase-1 audit and this discovery report (§7 item 4).

records.legacy_column: UNKNOWN — table does not exist in a clean local reset (discovery report Finding 3)
records.migration_rule: BLOCKED. Cannot design a migration rule for a table whose shape has never been observed.
records.unresolved_reason: store_items is referenced by the original Phase-1 audit as a dependency of backpack_items.item_id, but has no tracked migration and does not exist in a clean supabase db reset. Its production shape (if it exists at all) is completely unverified. Resolving this without querying production via the Supabase MCP would violate 'do not invent mappings.'
